metric_notes: Precision/recall are conditional on annotated-cell intersections with predicted cells and inferred unambiguous channels. Unknown cells are unscored. Scores are not calibrated probabilities.
sampling_policy: Every positive training candidate is visited each epoch, then reshuffled if more batches remain. Balanced reviewed negatives; optional training-only hard-negative mining. Unknown candidates never sampled.

hard_negative_mining.policy: Highest-scoring 5% of reviewed training negatives only. No validation/test or unknown candidates.

selection.policy: Validation only: maximize recall at target precision with at least 5 detections; otherwise maximize F0.5. Matching within same cell and channel at declared physical tolerance.
